news.title: Strategy earmarks $1.6 billion cash pool for treasury operations, buybacks
news.summary: Michael Saylor's Strategy set aside about $1.6 billion in cash to fund future treasury operations, ‌including potential bitcoin purchases and share buybacks, the ‌company disclosed in a regulatory filing on Monday.  The world's largest corporate buyer ​of bitcoin dubbed the liquidity pool "USD Cash," which will be different from a reserve it set up earlier to fund dividends on its preferred stock and interest on its ‌outstanding debt.  The new cash ⁠pool will have more flexible uses and could be used for bitcoin purchases, share buybacks ⁠and other corporate events.
